description: 17 synthetic payloads. No real prompts, responses or data of any kind: every text here was written for this spec. Seven texts cover the range of raw-signal behaviour; nine metadata variants cover every combination of present and absent fatigue inputs. Texts 1-7 appear with no metadata at all, which is what every caller in this repo does today; the remaining ten pair a text with a metadata variant.
